correctness.rationale: Normal form is an exact weighted homogeneous identity; the nonzero generic Hessian isolates a singular component. D and p are prime by irreducibility in disjoint variables and monic localization. The function field on w=1 is purely transcendental over F(sqrt(u(4q-1))), and u stays nonsquare because u and 4q-1 have independent prime valuations; thus component cover is connected. Exact identities checked by packaged standard-library program.
